title: BillingVibesChargeRefundedPayload
description: billing.vibes.charge.refunded v1 (OpenVibe.Billing, written when a Vibes Pay charge is refunded): the app's charge and the opaque payer reference. This is also the Vibes Pay webhook body (HMAC-SHA256 with the app's webhook secret, retried with backoff). It deliberately carries no person id and no email, only payer_ref, stable per app, so an app can recognise a returning payer without receiving their identity. amount is whole Vibes. Envelope: subject { type: vibes-charge, id: vch_... }, actor service:billing.

id.description: The charge; GET /api/v1/vibes/charges/:id returns its current state.

app.description: The app that created the charge.

project_id.description: The app's project, whose Vibes wallet received the charge.

amount.description: The whole number of Vibes paid.

reference.description: The app's reference, as given when the charge was created.

paid_at.description: When the Vibes moved from the person to the project.

refunded_at.description: When the Vibes went back to the person.

sandbox.description: True for a sandbox app: sandbox Vibes only, worth nothing.

payer_ref.description: Opaque reference for the paying person, stable per app. Never the person's id, email or any other identity; an app uses it to recognise a returning payer.
